protocol.population: Original 497 five-frame PINNS test windows, already used throughout development. 21 clips, four previously examined sites. Graph inputs apply to graph-enabled M2b/M2/M3 and full models. M0 and M1 in the separate four-site retraining use no neighbor graph.
protocol.edge: Directed neighbor-to-ego slots, at t0. Keep 0.00001 < ground distance <= 10 metres, nearest first, at most 12. A window can have multiple slots, and consecutive windows can observe the same pair.
protocol.type: Raw Person or Car labels. Assigned tensor slots use eight-dimensional one-hot: person standing when fixed flag==1 or valid speed <0.20 m/s; otherwise walking-person code, even if velocity missing. All non-person objects map to passenger-car code. Physical riders, disability/assistance or vehicle subtypes cannot be identified from these labels.
protocol.time: Separate known test-window selection (requires at least 15 annotated future frames) from graph construction. Recompute every retained input tensor from source detections limited to t0-5..t0. Five-frame observation ratios cover t0-4..t0; velocities choose nearest available same-type/ID detection among t0-1..t0-5. No coordinates after t0 enter edges. This is an input audit, not an online trigger or static-map validation.
protocol.radial: If both velocities exist, v_rad = -dot(p_j-p_i,v_j-v_i)/(distance+1e-6); positive means distance decreasing. The 1 m/s cutoff is descriptive. Invalid velocities yield zero plus mask=0; valid zero means no measured radial motion. All positions/IDs are label-supplied, not detector estimates.
protocol.ablation: The M2b_norad model masks the explicit radial scalar before graph processing. Relative position, distance and relative velocity remain, so the underlying radial relation can still be derived from the other channels.
protocol.verification: Compared all 12x9 edges, 12x8 neighbor one-hot and 12 masks exactly with the unmodified archived input builder on every original held-out window. Verified materialize_window_split(t_obs=5) forwards all three arrays unchanged. Independently checked distance, radial sign/magnitude and typed slot order against raw actor IDs.
